findings.title: Absolute local-home paths appear in some CommandFailure error strings
findings.summary: A few storage/mission error branches embed absolute host paths via path.display() into CommandFailure.message that is surfaced to the webview. For this single-user local desktop app (which already displays localHome in the UI by design) no trust boundary is crossed; recorded informationally against invariant 1's 'no absolute host path leak' phrasing. Precondition: a local storage/mission error occurs (non-private home dir, unavailable workspace/target). Remediation: optionally keep absolute paths in private local-home logs and surface only relative names in CommandFailure.message; not required for the local threat model.

evidence.label: path in error string
evidence.explanation: ProductionError::InvalidHome formats the absolute path; mission_runner refused() messages embed path.display(). Both reach the frontend via CommandFailure.message.
evidence.excerpt: "local home path is not a private directory: {}", path.display()

evidence.label: already surfaced by design
evidence.explanation: SystemStatus.local_home is intentionally shown in the UI (App.tsx:299), so no additional cross-boundary disclosure occurs in the local single-user model.
